runtimeEscalation.reason: Runtime UI and input evidence require a separate authorized capability.

caseAssertions.normal-input: A valid IntentSpec selects one registered primary action and compatible screen family.
caseAssertions.invalid-input: Unknown fields, actions, families, states and malformed values are rejected.
caseAssertions.denied-expansion: Business payloads and runtime behavior flags are rejected.
caseAssertions.repeat-idempotency: The same IntentSpec produces the same validation hash.
caseAssertions.hash-change-cache-invalidation: Changes to the contract or registry invalidate the source hash.
caseAssertions.interruption-recovery: An incomplete replay is not accepted without a fresh receipt.
caseAssertions.deterministic-output: Normalized result fields are stable and sorted.

responsibilityScope: Static semantic planning only; no Unity or runtime claim.

specializedAcceptance.title: IntentSpec v1 static planning
specializedAcceptance.runtimeBoundary: Static checks do not prove runtime menus, input, Unity assets or visual fidelity.
